changelog:
Initial release of Slack Integration skill:

- Send messages, manage channels, upload files, and automate notifications in Slack via Web API, CLI, or API.
- Supports sending plain, threaded, scheduled, and formatted (Block Kit) messages.
- Allows channel management: list, create, get info, set topic, and fetch history.
- Provides file upload (v2 API) and remote file link sharing.
- Enables adding message reactions and accessing user info/lookups.
- Includes practical setup instructions, API usage examples, and common workflow recipes.
summary: Slack messaging — send messages, manage channels, upload files, add reactions, and automate team notifications via CLI and API.
